LESSON: KUANDIKA 14.3.1 INSHA ZA MAELEKEZO

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo
2. kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo.
4. Show that you can: kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 14.3.1 Insha za Maelekezo important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya maelekezo
2. kuandika insha ya maelekezo akizingatia vipengele vyake muhimu

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
